questions.text: Which sequence best matches the checked cast-in-place concrete workflow?

options.text: Supply and store materials, mix, transport, place, compact, and cure the concrete in its formwork
Deliver finished precast units and skip all site placement
Install rebar only after the concrete has cured
Select paint finishes before concrete is transported

questions.rationale: Chudley/Greeno describes concreting as material supply and storage, mixing, transporting, placing, compaction, and curing.
questions.explanation: Precast involves factory fabrication and on-site assembly, not in-place construction. CIP requires active curing processes, not passive delivery. Concrete placement and curing are integral to CIP. CIP construction consists of building temporary formwork, placing reinforcement per drawings, pouring concrete (by pump or bucket), vibrating to consolidate, and curing moisture/temperature-controlled on-site. All strength gain occurs in place, enabling site customization and monolithic structural behavior.

questions.text: What is the main source-safe role of formwork in reinforced concrete work?

options.text: It temporarily shapes and supports wet concrete until the member can hold its intended form
It permanently replaces reinforcing bars
It is only a decorative finish template
It is used only after the slab is cured

questions.rationale: Formwork is a temporary mold and support system for wet concrete.
questions.explanation: Over-vibration degrades quality, not improves it. Vibration duration has major impact on quality. Over-vibration reduces bond by causing paste separation. Over-vibration causes segregation: coarse aggregate settles while paste rises, creating weak upper layers and voids below. Surface blowholes (small bubble cavities) indicate excess air removal and paste migration. Under-vibration leaves voids and poor consolidation. Proper vibration (20–30 seconds per placement zone) is optimum; operator training and equipment maintenance are critical for quality.

Assuming concrete work has no sequence
Treating rebar as a paint material
